hypothesis: 在环境、感知处理链、资源模型、训练预算和编码结构固定时，当已到达数据存在延迟、缺失或来源不一致时，显式使用信息年龄、估计协方差和基于可观测残差的来源一致性指示量，相比不使用它们，能否降低教学服务任务完成率的最差场景退化，且不增加资源超支。

fixed_system.perception_chain: existing sensor -> communication -> nearest-neighbor Kalman fusion chain

feature_rules.disabled_features: same input slots are set to zero; dimensions and network structure stay unchanged
feature_rules.source_consistency_definition: 1 / (1 + mean(residual_m / reported_sigma_m)) over arrived track-source evidence
feature_rules.source_consistency_warning: uncalibrated relative consistency indicator; not an error probability or correctness probability

training_budget.checkpoint_rule: validation only; maximize mean service completion subject to resource conservation, then lower expiry, then earlier checkpoint

scenarios.handover: reuse S6 geometry through the fixed resource closed-loop handover layout
scenarios.communication_timing: reuse S7 communication delay, loss, outage, recovery congestion and reordering parameters
scenarios.system_bias: reuse S8 remote sensor bias parameters; the scheduler cannot read the injected bias labels

development_mechanism_check.claim_limit: mechanism check only; no significance claim and no test-set tuning

metrics.stability_definition: report minimum and range across fixed scenario-seed cells; lower worst-case degradation is better
